points.why: Names the Attractiveness Principle and describes several limits binding in turn as the project grows.
Explicitly says relieving one limit just moves the constraint to the next.
Says the missing decision is which unattractiveness to accept on purpose, but never says that not choosing lets whichever limit binds first decide.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly links the bottlenecks to the same growth and explains why they only look unrelated.
